title: Writing / Brand Narrative / Brand personality
slide_intent: Define personality through behavior so abstract traits can guide words that people actually encounter.
strategic_value: Five explained traits can help Duolingo sound welcoming and energetic without relying on a single catchphrase.
demonstration: The right panel pairs Inspiring, Inclusive, Can-do, Curious and Quirky with explanatory paragraphs.
practical_value: Use the behavioral descriptions to evaluate whether a message conveys the intended personality.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the Brand Personality title and desired-perception caption at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Arrange five labeled rows at right, keeping each trait beside its explanation.

reference_purposes.Intent: The caption identifies the traits as how the brand wants to be perceived; the explanations connect inclusion and play to access and learning.
reference_purposes.Application: Each trait is paired with language describing how it should appear in communications.
